title: Calgary Stampede On Hold
summary:
Calgary Stampede On Hold
The Canadian oil industry faces multiple challenges The Canadian oil industry has been hit hard by the combination of rising shale oil production in the U.S. (by far Canada's largest customer) and falling oil prices. While these challenges have not had a significant impact on Canadian crude oil production to date, it will start to slow the growth of crude oil supply after 2020.
